description: Score a website's Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) readiness from 0 to 100. Returns the score, letter grade, schema coverage breakdown, technical signals (og:image, h1 count, canonical, etc.), and red flags. Use this when you want to know how citable a site is to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, and Google AI Overviews. More at neverranked.com.

url.description: Full URL of the website to scan, including protocol. Example: https://example.com
